contract_assessments.assessment: [contract:A03; lean:Aiyagari1994.stationaryAssetSupply_continuous; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M06D/ParameterContinuity.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean; ledger:A03] The implemented mean-assets argument is mathematically sound: it derives common compact support for the sequence tail and limit, obtains uniform policy convergence, applies weak convergence to a bounded clipped policy, and establishes integrability before decomposing asset supply. However, the designated export proves continuity only along graphs phi : ImpatientPrices m → ℝ, with Continuous phi. This does not state joint continuity throughout the original admissible economic parameter region. Normalization sends (r,w,phi) to (1+r,w,-r*phi); at r=0, distinct admissible debt limits have the same normalized price. Consequently, independent debt-limit variation cannot be represented by the export's single-valued phi(q). The available stationaryMeanShiftedAssets_continuous theorem makes the missing joint-continuity conclusion straightforward, but that conclusion and its economic parameter coverage must actually be exported. The ledger replaces the original contract with the narrower graph formulation. Restore full parameter coverage without changing A03 or previously accepted contracts.

blocking_findings: [contract:A03; lean:Aiyagari1994.stationaryAssetSupply_continuous; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean; context:qualifications] The public signature restricts the debt shift to a continuous function of normalized prices. This excludes independent debt-limit variation on normalization fibers: with r=0 and fixed w, every nonnegative phi gives q=(1,w,0), while stationary net assets equal the same shifted mean minus phi. A03 requires continuity throughout the admissible parameter region, not merely on each selected graph. Export joint continuity in (q,phi), or continuity for arbitrary continuous parameterizations q(theta), phi(theta), and explicitly connect economic use to normalization. The existing mean-continuity proof supplies the substantive analytic work.

[context:qualifications] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive states. Never interpret rightMarginalValue m 0 as the economic boundary marginal. That boundary is zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal and may be infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal is a separate utility endpoint object. H06 and contract D02 use no marginal object; contract D03 and S02 use rightMarginalValue only after proving positivity. A01, A02, and the present A03 argument introduce no marginal-object boundary substitution.

[context:qualifications] The maintained household scope is bounded utility, continuous resources, and a general compact iid-income law. P03's two-point distribution establishes primitive consistency only. Unbounded log/CRRA utility and serially correlated income remain outside scope. H01–H04 retain BASIC-only assumptions and constructed canonical objects without impatience. H01 is a bounded-continuous Bellman self-map on unbounded NNReal with beta contraction; actual actions lie in [0,z] and shares are auxiliary. H02 constructs the canonical fixed point, uniqueness among bounded continuous fixed points, uniform value iteration, and bounds using inf U and sup U over all nonnegative consumption. H03 establishes real convex-combination concavity and strict increase without derivatives. H04 constructs the unique actual shifted-asset maximizer, uses shares only at positive resources, handles zero by feasibility, and satisfies c(z)+A(z)=z. No CoreRegularity, impatience, differentiability, invariant-law, bounded-asset, or finite-state assumption enters H01–H04.

dimension_assessments.summary: The export proves continuity only for a global continuous debt-shift graph over normalized prices. At r=0, different debt limits share the same normalized price, so this signature does not express full joint continuity throughout the original admissible parameter region.

The stated graph theorem is proved correctly: enlarge tail and limit supports to one compact interval, bound the varying-policy integral by its uniform norm, use a clipped fixed test for weak convergence, and subtract the integrable debt shift.

The integrand is shifted saving A(z) minus the debt shift, matching A94 equation (8). Original-price interpretation still requires nonnegative phi and intercept=-(R-1)*phi. No independence of current saving and contemporaneous labor is asserted.

Rendered A93 printed 39–40/original PDF 40–41 states invariant-law continuity. Rendered A94 printed 667–670/original PDF 10–13 supplies timing and equation (8) on p. 668. The compact-support integral split is a new proof; SLP dependence is through accepted S06.

Actual premises are BASIC, smoothness, eventual curvature, endpoint nondegeneracy, fixed iid labor law, strict impatience in the price subtype, and continuous phi. Local D03 bounds are derived, not assumed.

No asset-supply continuity, moment convergence, or invariant-law conclusion is assumed. Continuous debt shifts include constants; strict impatience permits R=1 because beta<1. The premises are not vacuous.

The proof uses accepted policy continuity, local drift support, weak stationary-law continuity, and asset integrability/decomposition. The semantic diff adds M06D and audits without altering accepted results.

Resources remain NNReal and labor has an arbitrary probability law on a compact interval with essential endpoint neighborhoods. No finite-state approximation, density, or finite-support income restriction appears.

M06D uses policy feasibility and continuity on [0,B], including zero, without evaluating any marginal object. It never substitutes rightMarginalValue m 0 for the separate, possibly infinite ENNReal zeroRightMarginal.

Compact support proves asset-policy integrability under each relevant law. Both terms are integrable before integral_sub, and constants are integrable under probability laws. No unchecked ENNReal-to-Real marginal conversion supplies a finite economic expectation.

Weak convergence is applied only to the bounded continuous clipped limiting policy. Common compact support makes clipping exact and uniform policy convergence controls the changing integrand. Mean continuity therefore does not rely on weak convergence alone.

Strict impatience is explicit in ImpatientPrices and assigned by A03. No consumption positivity, positive minimum income, density, labor-mean-one premise, or global uniform impatience margin is introduced.
The inspected proof uses analytic lemmas and ordinary tactics. Controller checks report no sorry or prohibited bypasses, and every new export has assert_no_sorry coverage.
The packaged actual axiom records cover all ten new exports; the 518-declaration union contains only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. Both audit files print the new exports' axioms.

All ten new-export names match the signature and axiom inventories and have all three audit commands. The exact public signature exposes phi : ImpatientPrices m → ℝ and Continuous phi; its scope defect is recorded in D01.

The ledger accurately describes the submitted graph theorem and REVIEW_READY status, but replaces the original full-region Mathematical contract with that narrower formulation. Synchronization must include the unchanged intended contract and the missing joint debt-coordinate coverage.

The proof establishes a genuine stationary economic mean, but the designated net-asset theorem stops at continuous debt-shift graphs. It must export the joint dependence needed when original debt limits vary independently, especially on the r=0 normalization fiber.

Replacing independent economic parameter variation by a globally single-valued phi(q) is an unapproved restriction of the claimed parameter coverage. The inherited normalization qualification does not authorize dropping the debt coordinate where normalization loses it.

New helpers concern compact policy restriction, clipping, support enlargement, integrability, and stationary mean continuity. No divergence, equilibrium, goods-clearing, or other later-contract economics is implemented.

Successful builds and a sound integral proof do not establish exact A03 completion. The export and ledger still restrict parameter coverage. A same-gate joint-continuity revision is available from the existing mean theorem, so GREEN is not justified yet.
